mode: generated AC1024 production-writer/reader round-trip fast slice
scope: Retain DWG HEADER CMC method, RGB, optional color name, optional color-book name, and source version beside the existing normalized scalar

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: ODA §9 identifies CECOLOR, DIMTFILLCLR, DIMCLRD, DIMCLRE, DIMCLRT, and INTERFERECOLOR as CMC-valued variables. §2.11 defines the CMC method byte, RGB payload, optional color-name and color-book-name strings.

dxfMappingAudit.reference: Autodesk DXF Reference, HEADER section and system-variable group-code tables
dxfMappingAudit.finding: The reviewed reference documents scalar group mappings for these HEADER variables but does not establish class-specific truecolor, color-name, or color-book extensions. No generic 420/430/431 mapping was inferred; the DXF reader/writer mapping is unchanged.

localSource.finding: The HEADER parser previously retained only getCmColor's normalized integer, and the writer regenerated an indexed method. DRW_Variant now carries immutable DWG CMC sidecar metadata while preserving its scalar value. Parsing uses the bounded detached string stream for modern versions; writing validates method/scalar/RGB/name-flag consistency, requires the specification-reserved index to be zero, and refuses unsupported or unrepresentable state.
localSource.compatibility: DRW_Variant public size/layout changes; downstream consumers must rebuild. No virtual interface changed. Scalar-only DXF-origin values retain the existing behavior.

generatedControls.finding: A locally generated DWG round trip covers C0 ByLayer, C1 ByBlock, C2 RGB with and without color/book names, and C3 ACI across all six HEADER CMC variables. It verifies normalized scalar and sidecar values plus DRW_Header copy/assignment. Unsupported C4 and a nonzero reserved CMC index fail before publication, preserve seeded outputs, and corrected retries on the same writer succeed.
generatedControls.fixturePolicy: The generated DWG is created in the system temporary directory and removed by the test; no persistent DWG/DXF fixture is added.
generatedControls.limit: Generated local codec consistency is not producer-authored or independent semantic evidence and does not establish DXF color-group mappings.

productionSummary: Add DWG-only CMC metadata to DRW_Variant and preserve it through copy/move; scalar mutation clears stale metadata.
Capture all six HEADER CMC values, including optional names from the bounded detached string stream.
Emit validated supported C0-C3 metadata, require the specification-reserved index to be zero, and preserve scalar-only behavior and existing DXF mappings.
